title: The fixed rule on net1 v4, v3 and the true BDP: test links, once
description: The single test run of the fixed rule (window = 2^u times net1's believed BDP), with each net1's u as chosen on the validation links (exp-rule-net1v4-val-11): net1 v4 (exp-net1v4-grid-10's chosen run) at u = 0.125, net1 v3 at 0.375 and at its earlier 0.25 (the released rule), the true BDP at 0.375, and the learned net2 on net1 v3 (learned-td3bc-n40-s0), against all 17 kernel controllers on the 27 test links: the training conditions at 20 s and 60 s (campaign seed 13), the new, deep-long and cubic-first families (seed 31), and, test only, BBRv3 or Westwood competing from 0 s for 60 s (seed 31), the competitors neither net1 trained on. Steps keep their labels and actions, not their observation vectors (experiments/slim_steps.py).
prepare: G="$IN/grid/$(cat "$IN/grid/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; M="$IN/models"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v4" "$G" --u 0.125; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v3" "$M/net1v3.pt" --u 0.375; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/oracle" "$M/net1v3.pt" --u 0.375 --oracle; P=(--policy "v4-u0.125=$OUT/v4/rule-u0.125.onnx" --policy "v3-u0.375=$OUT/v3/rule-u0.375.onnx" --policy "v3-u0.25=$M/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "oracle-u0.375=$OUT/oracle/rule-u0.375-oracle.onnx" --policy "learned-s0=$M/learned-td3bc-n40-s0.onnx"); experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" test 13 31 all "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-held-competitors-60" --split test --family held-competitors --duration-ms 60000 --seed 31 --stock all "${P[@]}"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-held-competitors-60/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-held-competitors-60"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
